description:
This world-record-breaking Intamin Exa coaster opened on the last day of 2025 and is the tallest, fastest, and longest coaster on the planet! It stands 534.8 feet (163 m) tall with a top speed of 155.3 mph (250 km/h) and uses a LSM (Linear Synchronous Motor) lift hill launch, plus two more LSM launch boosts to propel the vehicle around the 13,943.6 feet (4,250 m) of track.
This Six Flags park is located in Qiddiya near Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
